summary: New Mountain Private Credit Fund filed Form 8-K covering three items: an unregistered sale of 11,364 common shares at $23.32/share for $0.3M aggregate consideration under Regulation D; a regular monthly distribution of $0.19/share declared by the Board; and monthly NAV disclosure of $23.32/share as of April 30, 2026. No M&A, restructuring, activist, or other special-situation event is present. This is a routine periodic filing providing operational and capital activity updates, and does not constitute a special situation for event-driven analysis.
